git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "fix(tools): require ajv, not ESM named import

CI reproduced TS2693 ('Ajv' only refers to a type) that a local tsc
did not: under NodeNext an ESM named import of ajv's CommonJS class
is not reliably a value. The same fragility left registry.ts
unimportable at runtime on CI, so the suites importing it as a value
failed to load and src/orchestration coverage fell to 7.36% against
its ratchet.

Load the class through createRequire, as requireOptionalPeer already
does for CJS peers (inlined here because orchestration may not import
providers), and type it with a type-only import query.

Refs #37
